messages:
Ava (Product): Quick sync — need alignment on the Adaptive Prewarm pilot for AcmeCorp. They want a private deploy (VPC) + HSM-backed keys + burst prewarm for Black Friday traffic. Can we map owners and launch criteria?
Maya (Runtime): High level: runtime can add prefix caching + auto-prewarm policy. Need GPU pool reserved or warm pool.
Sam (Infra): We can do warm pool but need headroom calc. How many concurrent streams? @Nora what's Acme's expected qps? :eyes:
Nora (Solutions): They expect ~120 qps steady, bursts to ~600 qps for ~15m windows.
Diego (SRE): That implies ~X nv4s GPUs if we want p95 < 300ms. I'll run sims and post numbers.
Maya (Runtime): Will run perf sim. Feature dependency: runtime needs KV-cache serialization for private deploys (security flagged experimental).
Priya (Security): KV serialization + HSM okay in principle, but need threat model signoff and documented KMS envelope flow. Also need customer proof-of-encryption.
Ava (Product): Proposed launch criteria:
```
- Functional: private deploy + prewarm working end-to-end
- Perf: p95 <= 300ms under expected load for a 2-week pilot
- Security: KMS/HSM audit and threat model signoff
- Reliability: automatic fallback to hosted model within 60s on capacity failure
- Ops: runbook, dashboards, cost estimate, rollback plan
```
Maya (Runtime): Agree. Runtime owner: Maya. Need infra to pin capacity and expose warm-pool API.
Sam (Infra): I'll own warm-pool and capacity reservation. Rough timeline: prototype in 2w, capacity production-ready in 6w (pending quota). Need a quota commit.
Priya (Security): I'll own threat model + KMS runbook. Need access to customer's HSM test creds and KMS policy examples.
Nora (Solutions): I'll broker HSM test creds and provide a representative synthetic workload.
Diego (SRE): I'll own runbook and prewarm monitoring. Suggest an alert: warm-pool depletion > 5% triggers auto-burst fallback and ops paging.
Ava (Product): Primary risks: 1) capacity overcommit causing degraded latency, 2) perf regressions when prefix cache hits drop, 3) compliance delays on HSM onboarding. Mitigations: conservative initial reserve, canary rollout, security parallel onboarding.
Sam (Infra): Can someone give a firm GPU quota ask? I'll need exact numbers to reserve.
Maya (Runtime): Early sim will produce rough GPU counts. Operational question: need a config flag in model config, e.g.:
```
model.config.private_prewarm: true
prewarm.min_warm_instances: 10
prewarm.burst_window: 15m
```
Priya (Security): That config must be stored encrypted in the config store with KMS envelope; include ACLs.
Ava (Product): Action items (tentative):
- Sam: confirm GPU quota by Fri EOD
- Maya: prototype KV serialization + perf sim by next Tue
- Priya: draft threat model + KMS flow by Thu
- Diego: dashboard skeleton + alerts by next Wed
- Nora: get test HSM creds by Fri
If anyone has objections, call them out now, otherwise I'll consolidate into a PRD and send to stakeholders. :thumbsup:
Maya (Runtime): 👍 starting tomorrow.
Sam (Infra): 👍 working the quota ask with cloud ops.
Priya (Security): Noted — will start draft.
Diego (SRE): On it — will post dashboard link when ready.
Nora (Solutions): Preparing HSM onboarding checklist.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: warm-pool-sim -> staging at 2024-10-12T10:30Z :rocket:
Ava (Product): Thanks all — I'll draft the PRD and ping infra/security for the commit thread.
